purpose: ORG-derived experimental growth of standalone filled rectangular copper contributions, without contour recesses, while reserving the full original gap to nearby native traces.
eligibility: Standalone filled F.Cu source polygon with exact supported geometry, four unique vertices, adjacent perpendicular edges, and equal opposing sides. The complete 1.25x per-axis growth envelope must fit inside the registered crop; otherwise preserve the whole source shape unchanged. Retain exact source spans and do not infer pad or net identity.
factor_basis: Owner-directed bounded experiment with a hard 1.25x ceiling on each source-local axis; not a manufacturing sizing rule.
contour_rule: Every proposal remains one complete rectangle in the source-local axes. Original and T01 circle occupancy plus the 0.02002 mm construction gap is protected; neighboring copper may limit either growth axis, but must never carve, recess, notch, or round a rectangular contour.

side_trace_gap_reservation.definition: For each ORG rectangle and nearby native F.Cu segment/arc within the complete maximum-growth envelope, measure Euclidean surface-to-surface gap from the original rectangle. Reserve max(minimum_retained_gap_mm, 1.0 * measured_ORG_gap) for future trace work. T02 does not modify trace geometry or infer electrical connectivity.

scene_update: Deterministic source-center Y, X, then source-identity order. Each proposal sees all original F.Cu, the complete accepted T01 scene, prior accepted T02 additions, and trace reservations. Original source copper remains unchanged.
protected: the complete accepted T01 scene and its round priorities
accepted T01 square-recess or negative geometry when explicitly represented; otherwise its accepted neighborhood remains no-write protected
limitations: Source graphics do not supply a native pad/net identity or prove a trace-to-land electrical relationship.
The selected crop uses a screenshot locator with at least 0.0223 mm raster uncertainty.
No electrical, native-export, manufacturing, or EDIT-equivalence claim is made.
The retained ORG trace gap is a conservative geometric reservation, not proof of a qualified future trace-width/clearance envelope.
